[SWS_TcpIp_00124] ⌈DataPtr shall either point to a linear buffer of Available-
Length bytes containing the data for transmission or be a NULL_PTR. For data trans-
mission the service TcpIp_TcpTransmit() shall either use all data from the linear
buffer if DataPtr is not a NULL_PTR, or retrieve up to AvailableLength data bytes
from the upper layer by calling <Up_CopyTxData>() one or multiple times in the con-
text of this service otherwise.⌋
